publicFlow: Customer adds quick wins or services to quote.
Quote builder recommends a bundle when selected services overlap.
Customer reviews selected items and safe-intake warning.
Admin reviews quote request and converts later to ticket/project/customer workflow.
adminFlow: Review selected products, intake answers, recommendations, and promo eligibility.
Adjust scope or convert into project/ticket/lead later.
Record follow-up notes and status changes.
guardrails: No payment capture required for scoped services unless explicitly implemented safely
Quote is not a final contract unless human-approved
